editorial: Get ready for the ultimate spectacle of brute force and martial prowess. 'Baki Hanma VS Kengan Ashura' is less a movie and more a visceral, adrenaline-fueled brawl that demands to be seen on the biggest screen possible. The crossover successfully delivers unprecedented action choreography, pitting two of the most mythic fighters in the genre against each other in a breathtaking display of martial arts mastery.
